Entry Heirs Heirs are considered future land, surnames and responsibilities from birth. The elders will teach him or her etiquette and calculations, others will speculate on his or her abilities, but the heir himself or herself may not have the right to choose who he or she wants to be; a family tree is often written earlier than personal wishes. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
